# foundation expansion

this branch expands the initial native bootstrap into a layered foundation for the puterforge coding environment.

## added

- reusable native window abstraction
- native application state model
- ai client abstraction
- dynamic puter model catalog
- agent group abstraction
- tool registry
- first orchestrator loop
- javascript runtime validation in ci

## next

- winui 3 shell
- project explorer and editor
- terminal service
- c++ ↔ javascript messaging
- model picker ui
- multi-agent orchestration
